SUPPORT_DESCRIPTION: Voluntary support for the development of Plervo.
SUPPORT_HTML:
Plervo aims to make working with documents more accessible. Your support helps with development, testing, distribution and maintenance.

Support on Buy Me a Coffee ↗

A contribution, by choice.

Support is voluntary and does not unlock app features. Payments are handled by Buy Me a Coffee: Plervo does not receive or store your card details.

The payment service opens only when you choose its link. We do not load its widgets or trackers on this website.
SECURITY_DESCRIPTION: How Plervo tests releases, distributes packages and handles security reports.
SECURITY_HTML:
Plervo PDF 0.1.0-alpha.1 is available for testing on Macs with Apple Silicon. It is an experimental release, not a production-ready version.

What has been checked

  • Automated tests on macOS, Windows and Linux, plus dependency and licence checks.
  • PDF editing, save/reopen, forms, encryption, redaction and malformed-file handling with synthetic documents.
  • The final Mac app and command-line package, including signatures, Apple notarization, local use and malware scanning.
  • 15 minutes of fuzz testing: 188,495 runs without an observed crash or hang.

Official packages

The Mac publisher is Maintech Solutions LLC. Get the files and SHA-256 checksums from the official alpha release. A checksum verifies integrity; a signature helps verify the publisher. Windows awaits SignPath approval; Linux still needs native interface validation.

Known limits

Use copies of documents. OCR currently targets English; multilingual OCR is not supported. Some Chinese and Telugu UI characters can be missing without system font fallback. Clean-machine Mac installation, upgrades, complete language review and native Windows/Linux interface checks remain pending.

No audit or malware scan guarantees the absence of vulnerabilities. See the release notes for the tested scope and remaining checks.

Report a possible vulnerability

Use the private security channel on GitHub and choose “Report a vulnerability”. Include the version, operating system and reproduction steps using a test document. Do not post passwords or personal documents in public issues.
PRIVACY_DESCRIPTION: Privacy on the Plervo website and in the PDF alpha.
PRIVACY_HTML:
This website

This site has no advertising cookies, analytics, forms or PDF uploads. Cloudflare, our hosting provider, may process technical connection details such as IP addresses to deliver and protect the pages.

Language and download suggestions

English is the default. Language links open the equivalent page in Portuguese or Spanish; your choice stays in the URL as you browse. We do not store it in cookies or local storage.

Operating-system suggestions use information already exposed by your browser, on your device. This information is not stored or transmitted. The suggestion does not identify your processor; check compatibility before downloading.

The app

PDF editing and bundled OCR run on your computer. Choosing “Check for updates” contacts GitHub for release information; it does not upload your PDF. Opening external document links or the support page uses your browser and the destination service. Local automation is disabled by default: the UI control channel must be explicitly enabled, is restricted to loopback and requires a session token. The separate command-line MCP interface also requires an explicit launch.

External services

Downloads are hosted on GitHub. The voluntary support link opens Ricardo Bonetti’s page, the creator of Plervo, on Buy Me a Coffee. Their privacy policies apply when you visit them.

Updated on October 15, 2026.
ABOUT_TITLE: Our own identity. An open foundation.
ABOUT_DESCRIPTION: Origin, authorship and credits of Plervo PDF.
ABOUT_HTML:
Plervo is an independent initiative. We are starting with Plervo PDF, based on version 0.8.0 of PdfCraft, with our own identity and ongoing review and security work.

We preserve the original authors’ credits and the MIT and Apache-2.0 licences of the base project. Libraries, icons and fonts retain their own licences, included with the packages.

Transparency from the start

The first public download is a Mac Apple Silicon alpha of Plervo PDF. Windows and Linux packages are still being prepared. The Plervo Suite app manager is not included yet. Features, requirements and limitations are described in the release notes.
